lessons.title: Class Pet Surveys
lessons.sourceGoal: Determine whether statements about data are true or false. Write statements about data from a visual representation.
lessons.gap: Need Grade 1-level first-party tally-chart examples and evaluate true/false statements against labeled values; re-check current family matches statement evaluation.

lessons.title: How Many? PLC Activity
lessons.sourceGoal: Answer "how many in each category" and "how many in all" questions about data represented in different ways.
lessons.gap: Source asks how many in each category and total, with tally marks and numbers; replace source-like quoted generic example with first-party concrete worked example and validate counting/addition family.

lessons.title: Questions About Data
lessons.sourceGoal: Ask and answer questions about data.
lessons.gap: Existing canonical worked examples are isolated arithmetic, not data-question construction/answering. Needs a data-table/graph activity and corresponding reviewed Practice contract.

lessons.title: Center Day 3
lessons.sourceGoal: Build toward fluency by adding and subtracting within 10 in a way that makes sense to them. Sort objects into categories and represent the sort.
lessons.gap: Center mixes add/subtract within ten AND object sorting/display; existing generic arithmetic examples omit the sorting representation. Verify mixed skill coverage.

lessons.title: Animals in the Jungle (optional)
lessons.sourceGoal: Collect, organize, and represent data from survey questions. Create questions related to survey data. Interpret data to answer questions.
lessons.gap: Optional original survey/modeling lesson. Existing canonical examples include negative results inappropriate to Grade 1. Replace and align student-authored survey/representation Practice; preserve optional marker.

note: This is a read-only source/DB intake and initial gap classification, not an approved lesson release. Review effective learner-facing Rich V2 and actual runtime Practice before promotion.
